The [[Zhar system]] contained a single '''star'''. When the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was formed, billions of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], spinning gases from the system's sun coalesced into a single [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] planet, the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]].
